scenario: Nested `after` per LTAC.6.2.2 — an `after` body may contain further `after` clauses (the inner timer schedules from the outer's firing). Pin: a rule with `after 10_min:` nested inside `after 5_min:` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES. That the inner fires at outer-fire plus 10_min needs a run.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

rule cascading:
    Motion m where m.state == true
->
    log info "step 0"
    after 5_min:
        log info "step 1"
        after 10_min:
            log info "step 2"
